age.evidence: at the age of 62–68 weeks, all rats underwent two scanning sessions

sex.evidence: Twenty-five two-month-old female Wistar rats ... were used for the experiments

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg bodyweight, s.c.) was administered exactly 10 min after the start of the rsfMRI acquisition. Psilocybin ... was dissolved in Ampuwa (aqua ad iniectabilia).

group_housing.evidence: All animals were housed individually in standard rat cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-h artificial light/dark cycle (lights on at 6:00 a.m.)

judge_notes: Study contains no scoreable behavioural assays — the only in vivo readout in psilocybin-treated rodents is pharmaco-fMRI (resting-state functional connectivity under anesthesia), which is a neural-imaging readout, not a behavioural assay per rubric exclusion criteria.

Alcohol drinking measurement (ADE relapse intake) is a phenotyping measure used as a covariate; no psychedelic was administered during the drinking measurement, so it is not scored as a psychedelic-administration assay.

All three candidates correctly returned an empty assays list; identity and housing metadata reconciled via modal values. Sex n_female set to 25 (total enrolled female subjects per Methods); 4 controls were excluded post-hoc due to brain tumors.
